title: LSU’s MiLaysia Fulwiley arrested, cited for assault, battery and resisting police
content:
LSU senior guard MiLaysia Fulwiley was arrested and cited for aggravated assault, aggravated battery, resisting an officer and flight from an officer, according to East Baton Rouge Parish Prison records. She was listed as an inmate Sunday morning.

The East Baton Rouge Parish Prison did not confirm the details of her arrest.

An LSU spokesperson said in a statement: “We are aware of the situation and have no further comment at this time as it’s an ongoing legal matter.”

Fulwiley is in her second season at LSU after transferring from South Carolina. She is averaging 17.8 points and 4.3 assists through four games in her first season as a full-time starter.

The No. 9 Tigers host Troy on Monday night. Fulwiley is considered a potential first-round pick if she chooses to enter the WNBA Draft after this season.

This story will be updated.
